accountPreferences.autoSelectAudioDescription: On: picks the audio track in your preferred language whenever the file has one. Off: keeps the track the file marks as default.

about.basedOn: Based on Plezy. Popkino is an independent project, neither developed nor endorsed by the Plezy project.
about.sourceCodeQrHint: Scan this code with your phone to open the address

update.permissionExplanation: To install the update, allow Popkino to install apps.
update.permissionPathUnknownApps: Choose Popkino in the list, then turn on the permission.
update.permissionPathDeveloper: Developer options > Install unknown apps > Popkino
update.permissionPathGeneric: Settings > My Fire TV > Developer options > Install unknown apps > Popkino (or Settings > Security > Unknown sources)
update.permissionDenied: Installation is not possible without permission.
update.installing: Follow the on-screen instructions to install the update.
update.downloadFailed: The download failed. Check your connection.
update.notEnoughSpace: Not enough space to download the update.
update.signatureConflict: This version is signed with a different key than the installed one. Uninstall Popkino then install it again: you will need to add your servers again.

settings.audioChannelLimitOriginalDescription: Play every channel in the track. At launch, the audio track is not picked by channel count.
settings.audioChannelLimitSurround51Description: At launch, picks the track in your language with the most channels (5.1). Mixes 7.1 down to 5.1 for TVs and receivers that only take 5.1 PCM. Passthrough is unaffected.
settings.audioChannelLimitStereoDescription: At launch, picks the stereo track in your language. Mixes down to two channels for TV speakers, stereo speakers or headphones. Turns passthrough off.
